about: Renders a row of controls over a table or a list, with one tab stop for the row. The arrow keys move between the controls, and a narrow row folds the controls that matter least.

radius.about: Every corner of an outlined row.
radius.title: Corners

room.about: One row in three rooms. The row folds on its own width: in the narrow room, the secondary action shows its icon alone, and the tertiary action moves behind the folded control.
room.title: Rooms

searching.about: The search covers a narrow row while it is open. Opening it moves focus to the field, and closing it moves focus back to the control that opened it.
searching.title: Search

size.about: The three sizes. The size sets the gaps and the separator, and the buttons and the search field take the same size through their providers.
size.title: Sizes

title: Toolbar

variant.about: The three looks: plain, outline and surface. An outlined or surface row pads its controls by its own gap.
variant.title: Looks
